_comment: Living world: NPC Streetmon hunters, street chatter and speech bubbles, wild territory fights, packs, threats, aggressive Streetmon attacking the player, and the AI activity radius. Distances are metres, times seconds. Chatter lines take {placeholders}: species, level, district, street, strong / weak (a type and one it beats), track, racer, crew, item, name.

caught: Wait till the crew sees this.
won: Too strong for its own good.

tips: {strong} types wreck {weak} types.
Learned that one the hard way.
Wear 'em down before you throw.
Full health and the pod just bounces.
Nets for small fry, cages for the rare ones.
Cages cost a fortune though.
Rare ones come out at night.
That's why I never sleep.
Gun types don't flinch at gunfire.
Yeah, they come looking for it.
Sneak up slow, they don't spot you.
Sprint and they bolt.
Hold still and the ones in the sky come down.
Took me an hour once. Worth it, it was a {species}.
Sleep at a safehouse before a big job.
If it goes wrong you wake up there, not in the gutter.
Don't throw a pod when it's flying high.
Yeah, I lost three cages that way.
Lose the cops behind a building.
They only see what's in front of them. Mostly.
league: Commissioner's taking a cut, I bet.
Not for long if the League has a say.
My cousin slotted a {species} in his engine.
Cops set up roadblocks every time.
Dockside Dutch is taking challengers again.
Nobody's beaten Dutch in a year.
You heard what Mama Rust charges for a race build?
Worth every cent. My {species} rides in the trunk now.
brag: My {species} took down a Rebarb today.
news: Armored truck got hit last week.
Cash all over the street, I heard.
Streetmon fight on the corner earlier.
Stay off the sidewalk, these drivers are nuts.
Somebody drove a car into the pond again.
Third one this month. They should fence it.
The deli on the corner sold out of nets.
Everyone's after Quackpacks since the pond got lively.
Cops closed {street} for an hour last night.
Chase came right through. Lights everywhere.
life: I'm moving under the bridge. Cheaper, and nicer neighbours.
Night Owl Diner. Marge saves me the corner booth.
My boss wants the reports by Monday.
It's Friday night. Your boss can wait.
Kick the third machine from the left, works every time.
My {species} sleeps on my feet every night.
Through the park. The pond's pretty at this hour.
rumor: They say there's levels under the sewers.
Drains under the drains. Lockboxes nobody's opened in decades.
Something gold swims in the pond at night.
Big as a rowboat. Eats the coins people throw in.
Crates on the rooftops, full of gear.
Goldie at the pawn shop bought a city lockbox.
From the deep drains? Then someone's been down there.
Gulls at the docks steal straight out of your hands.
Those aren't gulls, they're Gullgrifters. Watch your wallet.
